title: Execute arbitrary Tactus procedures in the cloud, not only the three seeded kinds
description: assignment-action executeImmediateProcedureRun dispatches on papyrus-procedure-kind and supports only newsroom.research.explorer, newsroom.reporting.context and ingestion.reference.register; anything else throws Unsupported seeded procedure kind, and the runbook notes Lambda does not execute arbitrary Tactus source. A procedure saved in the newsroom therefore cannot run in the cloud. Needs a runtime that runs any published ProcedureVersion (for example a container Lambda or ECS task with tactus installed), with run records, logs and cost, and the 30 s procedure-action timeout out of the path.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built and live (2026-10-22). papyrus-procedure-runner (infra/procedures, a container Lambda with Tactus) runs any published ProcedureVersion: it loads the code and skill attachments, records the ProcedureRun through the external-execution path, runs Tactus in a child process with a deadline, and records the output or error. papyrus procedures register stores a site's .tac and skill files as a published version. PRs #501 #505 #509 #511 #534. First successful cloud run: Distinctive's TTAB ruling analysis, procedure-run-distinctive-ttab-ruling-analysis-20261022T045502138Z-4f19de5e, completed in 188 s. Tactus gaps fixed on the way: GPT-6 tools need the Responses API (Tactus #120, 0.53.1), Responses call duration (#121), a turn's tools override was ignored (#122, 0.53.3), declared output field types (#123). Not built: per-run cost and token records, a newsroom Run button for arbitrary procedures (procedure-action still dispatches only seeded kinds), runs longer than about 14 minutes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: arbitrary published procedures run in the cloud. Remaining gaps are listed in the previous comment.
